data.title: Reconcile Asterism design pack with current authority and evidence
data.description: Docs/design review of commits 71956ee5 and bfc39c54 in bn-2hkp. Verify: (1) R8 and all foreground gates distinguish the already-passed historical pre-flat-owner 1.20x threshold from forward BN-2SU-FINAL per-cell non-regression/p99/barrier budgets with predeclared tolerances and raw matrices; (2) research/07 preserves literature value while removing legacy migration fallback and current exact-dedupe promises; (3) research/13/ADR authority classification is complete and bn-3l8n remains the application/offline-tool adoption gate; (4) snapshot discovery is the sole live Fjall-backed state role while CLI metaread/doctor/inspect/retention and rebuild-index --meta remain direct operational consumers; (5) manifest coverage and protected 11/12 exclusions remain correct.
